title: fix: CORS headers + DO migration cleanup
body:
## Summary
- Fix CORS headers for credentialed requests from divine-relay-manager
- Add migration to delete orphaned `JobCoordinator` Durable Object that was blocking deployment

## Changes

### CORS fix
- Echo requesting origin instead of `*` for allowed origins (required when credentials/cookies are involved)
- Add `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true`
- Allow: `relay.admin.divine.video`, `*.divine-relay-admin.pages.dev`, `localhost:*`

### DO migration
- Add `[[migrations]]` with `deleted_classes = ["JobCoordinator"]` 
- The `JobCoordinator` class was deployed previously but never committed; this migration cleans up the orphaned DO namespace

## Deployment
Both fixes have been deployed and verified working on `realness.admin.divine.video`.

title: fix: CORS headers for credentialed requests from relay-manager
body:
Fix CORS headers to support credentialed requests from divine-relay-manager.                                                                                                   
																																											 
When CF Access cookies are involved, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` doesn't work - browsers require the specific origin to be echoed back with                               
`Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true`.                                                                                                                                      
																																											 
## Changes                                                                                                                                                                     
- Echo requesting origin instead of `*` for allowed origins                                                                                                                    
- Add `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true`                                                                                                                                 
- Allow: `relay.admin.divine.video`, `*.divine-relay-admin.pages.dev`, `localhost:*`                                                                                           
																																											 
## Deployment Blocked                                                                                                                                                          
Deployment fails with:                                                                                                                                                         
New version of script does not export class 'JobCoordinator' which is depended on by existing Durable Objects.                                                                 
																																											 
`JobCoordinator` doesn't exist in the codebase - it was removed previously but never migrated. Someone with context on whether this DO is still in use needs to add a          
delete-class migration to wrangler.toml before this can deploy:                                                                                                                
																																											 
```toml                                                                                                                                                                        
[[migrations]]                                                                                                                                                                 
tag = "v1"                                                                                                                                                                     
deleted_classes = ["JobCoordinator"]
